Application for Export Financing – Pre-shipment financing on open account basis / Sales Invoice Financing

We confirm that all necessary documents evidencing the transaction as required by you are enclosed herewith. We agree to be bound by your prevailing General Banking Terms and Conditions, applicable Jurisdiction Schedules and Trade Services Schedule (each as may be amended, supplemented, substituted and/or replaced from time to time). We confirm that we have been given such prevailing terms [or accessed them, where published, at bank.example/trade] and have reviewed them. 
 
We further confirm that we agree to each declaration of trust and trust receipt set out in Clauses 10.5 and 11 of the Trade Services Schedule relating to this Trade Service (if any) or any other Trade Service, and whether such Trade Services are provided to us before, on or after the date of this Form.
With respect to any charges, please debit our account number
With respect to any repayment for this financing, please debit our account number
Please debit all charges to our account no.
On maturity of the financing, you are authorised to debit our account no.

Without prejudice to the Application for Export Pre-Shipment & Open Account Post-Shipment Financing Terms and Conditions, if we do not indicate any specific account number, you are authorised to debit our account with you which is denominated in the same currency as the financing currency indicated in this Application.
